1. License & Usage
Lojia is an offline-first POS and shift management application. All data generated on this device is stored locally under the full control of the store owner.

2. Shift Ledger Accuracy
Cashiers and managers are responsible for entering accurate drawer counts, receipts, and cash movements.

3. Local Backups & Export
Data backups are created locally. Optional cloud exports or integrations operate only when configured by the user.

4. Updates
Periodic updates may include feature enhancements, security patches, and improvements.

1. Data Collection
Lojia processes sales transactions, inventory catalogs, cashier shifts, and business contact information locally on your Android device.

2. Security & Biometrics
Biometric authentication is handled strictly through the Android BiometricPrompt system. No biometric templates are stored in the application database.

3. Third-Party Integrations
Optional integrations (e.g. WhatsApp sharing, external storage, Printers) operate exclusively with explicit user permissions.

4. Data Retention
You may export or clear your local databases and records at any time.
